name: Picnic Beacon
story: Pip wants a lookout to find the picnic. Stack a cheerful beacon above the meadow.
objective: Lock 8 supported slabs above the foundation before the timer ends.
twist: A gentle first climb with three magnet charges and steady slide timing.
rule: Time 8 slab drops, alternate both slide directions, and keep enough overlap to support the tower.
controls: Space / tap: lock the moving slab. U or E: spend a magnet charge to snap and lock within the blue guide. Magnet locks break the perfect streak. Arrows and Q have no effect.
